name: FPS Optimizer Pro Mod
description: Pro FPS counter pinned to the top-left corner (color-coded, frame time, fully customizable) plus built-in performance tweaks for heavy levels: particle limiter and decoration hiding.

show-fps.name: Show FPS Counter
show-fps.description: Show the FPS counter in the top-left corner.

only-in-level.name: Only Show In Levels
only-in-level.description: Hide the counter in menus and only show it while playing or in the editor.

show-frametime.name: Show Frame Time
show-frametime.description: Also show the frame time in milliseconds.

color-code.name: Color-Coded FPS
color-code.description: Green when you hit your target FPS, yellow when slightly below, red when low.

update-interval.name: Update Interval (seconds)
update-interval.description: How often the displayed FPS value refreshes. Lower is twitchier, higher is smoother.

particle-density.name: Particle Density In Levels (%)
particle-density.description: Percent of particles that are allowed to spawn while you are in a level. 100 = vanilla, 0 = no new particles. Menus are not affected.

hide-decorations.name: Hide Decoration Objects
hide-decorations.description: <cr>Experimental.</c> Hides decoration-type objects while playing. Big FPS gain on heavy levels, but levels will look much plainer.
